description: Identity crosswalk between Open Domain Data registrar ids and the registrar ids used by the best-domain-registrars.com public data feed. Used by scripts/import-bdr.mjs to join records across the two catalogs. Matching key of record: the registrar's IANA-accredited identity; slugs happen to coincide today but the map is the contract, not the coincidence.
note: Keys are peer (BDR) ids, values are Open Domain Data registrar ids. unmatched_peer_ids are registrars the peer tracks that have no record in registrars.json yet; the importer skips their rows and reports them, it never invents registrar records (a new registrar record requires iana_id and goes through the normal contribution flow).
